selection_note: UPSTREAM UPGRADE BATCH 24 standard five-source cohort. Hypotheses, null cases and mechanisms were immutably preregistered at b4fcedc before fresh target implementation/issues/PR inspection; each row remains an unverified question, no CAS reservation, rights or product-benefit claim.

candidates.finding: Check whether independently running supported file tools can use aliases for one filesystem object yet acquire different S2 mutex keys, admitting conflicting edits.
candidates.screening_result: Prospective S2 prediction corroborated by pinned first-party Rust code and a distinct dev-alpha-2 Docker rust:1.91 native runner. Regression-only hard-link alias test failed on old PathBuf-keyed mutex (exit 101); exact bounded (device,inode)-key fix yielded 2/2 focused tests PASS, with original cancellation control, and full cargo test --lib 592/592 PASS. cargo fmt --check and git diff --check PASS, both archived final patches git apply --check on pristine reviewed SHA PASS. Rust 1.86/dependency lock issue required 1.91.1 and unlocked resolution; no model/provider, external PR or user benefit measurement.
candidates.observed_native_change: Separate dev-alpha-2 SSH native runner: source f1495e7, test-only session 0945f13f-ad83-4b16-8282-a0876daeff85 failed (expected RED, exit 101); fixed session 80b2d155-049d-4779-aa29-bd6160971d73 2/2 passed; library session 602c89c8-5363-4b87-9dc6-d7dc9db24e14 592/592 passed; Rust 1.91.1, matched local resolved dependency set; see independent receipt.

candidates.finding: Check whether concurrent supported Manager DAG Work requests sharing a budget key can both pass check-and-reserve and oversubscribe one remaining budget slot.
candidates.screening_result: The real reserveDagBudget function reads, checks, writes and records the requested usage within one better-sqlite3 transaction on a common namespaced SQLite record; the DB uses WAL and busy_timeout. No supported two-admission window bypassing the same transaction was found. Static control-path screen, not a concurrent native stress measurement; this prespecified oversubscription repair is not justified.

candidates.finding: Check whether an outgoing approval-paused tool call during the supported shared-container role cycle can be mislabeled to the successor or strand the transition.
candidates.screening_result: Current coordinator increments activeToolCalls before each policy-gated call and retains it during human escalation, even while releasing callMutex. loadPolicy quiesces admission, waits for active calls to drain, and atomically swaps policy/persona under both locks. Thus premature persona attribution is counterindicated, but a supported nonsettling approval/abort scenario and its terminal timeout are not proven here. The current default head has advanced since the Index review.
candidates.blocker: Need source-native bounded escalation callback/timeout fixture and supported workflow abort semantics before claiming a liveness failure or introducing a policy-cycle patch.

candidates.finding: Check whether a preferred pod selection path can reuse a pod across unlike owner, credential or work-purpose scopes despite the S2 isolation-key contract.
candidates.screening_result: Current podIsolationKey includes workspace, owner, purpose and credential profile; preferredPodId path explicitly checks pool, poolKey and full isolationKey. Regular, capacity and fallback pod selections filter by the same full identity key. No supported omission fitting the registered cross-principal reuse prediction found; static screen only, and current code differs from assessed review_ref.

candidates.finding: Check whether two concurrent project-session task-start requests after reassignment can both reserve nonterminal runs against a single durable task.
candidates.screening_result: Supported start_project_task preflights latest_run_id active/unknown reservations; reserve_task_start under the shared state mutex revalidates latest_run_id and expected assignee before writing a new run_id. A simultaneous competing request therefore encounters the changed reservation; reassignment protection is similarly compare-checked. No source-backed duplicate start found, static screen only.
